verdict.rationale: Parsec states that connections are peer-to-peer. One community user reports reaching their home PC over a 4G network, so remote access away from home is evidenced. The only documented alternative path is a high-performance relay, which is limited to Teams/Enterprise tiers, and nothing explains how the peer-to-peer path traverses NAT or what to do when it fails. missing for 10: documented NAT-traversal/port-forward setup, consumer-tier relay or fallback path, VPN guidance, in-depth connection-setup docs beyond marketing statements.

support.subject: As a power user, I can reach my machine away from home, with the relay, VPN, or port-forward path documented

citations.quote: All connections traveling through Parsec are peer-to-peer. They never pass through Parsec's infrastructure
The Parsec high-performance relay is also available to Enterprise customers so your team can connect through a relay point in your firewall.
Adds a high-performance relay for enhanced connection reliability
I can even play games from my PC over 4G network.
